```{r, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

The dataset IDs retrieve all verified series from their respective workbook.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(lcNRB)

prices <- lc_get("cpi")
money <- lc_get("monetary_survey")
external <- lc_get("balance_of_payments")
output <- lc_get("gdp_quarterly")
```

Every result uses the same long-form columns, so provenance can be retained
through an analysis.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
remittances <- lc_get("bop_workers_remittances")
remittances[c("period", "value", "unit", "vintage", "source_url")]

gdp_total <- subset(
  output,
  indicator_id == "gdp_total_unadjusted_level"
)
```

BOP observations are cumulative within a Nepalese fiscal year; they must not be
treated as independent monthly flows without an explicit transformation.
